title.label: Blast through podcasts, no chipmunk voices

content.label:
Has been a stable and easy to use app with well designed UI for many years and makes podcast listening easy to dive in and out without any tedious manual setup. The podcast art, chapters, and notes interface is fantastic for following along with podcasts that make lots of references.

Beyond that, the “twiddly knobs” are epic and I very much appreciate the attention to detail on the audio side. This isn’t just a podcast app, it’s an audiophile’s love letter to podcasts.

Smart speed does magical things to get me through podcasts at my pace (1.5x typical) with custom speeds per podcast feed, which is brilliant. It doesn’t sacrifice tonal quality or turn people’s voices into the chipmunks and actually does reasonably well with music on podcast intros. Thanks to the custom speed per feed, my music/audio nerd podcasts can be set to no speed manipulation while others can be sped up as much as I like, depending on how quick I can understand the people talking.

PS. Thank you thank you thank you for bringing back streaming. I quickly discovered my network/wifi connection is rarely great when starting a podcast. Ie. getting in the car still barely connected to wifi but not quite handed off to cellular or out on a walk/hike outside of town.
This is the best app for podcasts I’ve tried. It’s easy to customize and manage and I’ve never had issues with it skipping or losing where I am.

title.label: Liked, but recently GLITCHY AS HELL

content.label: I always felt like this app was decent enough. I used it as my sole podcast app. A few weeks ago they made changes. Now it has been glitchy as hell. I’ll be listening to a podcast and it just suddenly closes AND loses my place. I trusted it would get fixed ASAP but nope. Sadly gonna start moving over to a different app which is an annoying task…

This was once a great podcast app.  A couple months ago, it received an “update”, and since then it’s been all but unusable.  

Podcasts will download for a second and vanish.  Sometimes they’ll redownload later; often they won’t.  Some podcasts will actually download the way they’re supposed to, but many won’t.  There’s no way to know if you’re missing an episode of your favourite podcast, unless you go through every podcast one by one.

There are other more minor issues.  Podcasts which were downloaded suddenly become undownloaded, even though the per podcast episode limit hasn’t been reached.  Sometimes podcast will reset the position in the episode where you had stopped.

I have no idea why a developer would seemingly rewrite their application and break the core functionality.  It’s just mind blowing.

Longtime user, overcast has a home on my main app dock,  but it has become unusable with the app crashing every few minutes and resetting podcasts progress. When you pause a podcast it forgets and sends you back to the beginning, then when you try to fast forward it again crashes back to the beginning.
Playback is currently broken and makes the app unusable. Podcast suddenly stops and forgets progression.

Not sure what is going on with Overcast. Drops episodes in the middle of the podcast now ALL THE TIME. EVERYDAY . Starts back at the beginning???  Not sure what is happening . All of sudden I can’t use Overcast. After 10 years of use it is suddenly Unreliable and BROKEN.

Hey, I really love the app, but for a week or two now, it has been completely unusable. Either podcast will never play, or they will play and then stop a few minutes in and I’ll have to restart them and find my place every 5 to 10 minutes, it made it completely unuseable and forced me back onto the Apple app which I prefer to use. Hope you can fix it!

This latest update is the best of both worlds. It has the amazing performance of the new version and all the little convenient features of the original. 

I literally can’t think of a single issue now.

title.label: Why try to fix what wasn't broken?

content.label: This app used to be great. Reliable, easy to use. Then all these new updates changed things for no good reason, and it's a broken mess. Opening the app while listening to a podcast makes the podcast stop and the app forgets my position. Unacceptable.

title.label: Never written a review for anything

content.label:
But what did you do to this perfectly fine app. Honestly unusable now—is there a way to revert to the previous version?

^^This was my review when they nuked streaming

UPDATE: my podcasts don’t update, and they crash out every few minutes and stop playing. Making the leap somewhere else.. Way to ruin a perfectly fine app 👍

title.label: The downfall of this app is unmatched.

content.label:
This was the peak podcast app. No competition. Now, episodes delete  themselves as I listen, the app unsubscribes from random podcasts, new episodes are not downloaded automatically, many QOL features have a been deleted or changed into some clunky UX that hurts to use. 

The dev openly states that he doesn’t read feedback emails, so one star review it is. 

Hopefully Marco gets the message one day.

Each update is somehow worse than the last. Episode streaming has returned to Overcast, but now episodes randomly restart unless downloaded in full. This used to be a perfect app, now it’s borderline unusable.
Best podcast app I’ve ever used.
Stops playing and you loose your spot. Everytime you reopen app spot is also lost. I paid for premium, but it’s time to move onto something else.

Gave the app/Marco a few versions of the rewrite to iron things out. Happy to say all my paper cuts have been addressed and things that shouldn’t have been removed are back. Thank you for listening to your community. I now believe this is the number one podcast player app again. My favorite stat. “ Smart speed has saved you an extra 748 hours…”
Want to crash the app? Just click the Search icon to search for other podcasts - boom. Every time. Please fix when ready.
It's the best podcasting app I've used. No complaints. The 10th Anniversary edition with modern code base looks and works wonderfully. I highly recommend this app.
I have used this for a while, and the amount of time it drops my podcast, and fully resets is quite frustrating.

Sounds like a great app. Would love to be able to try it out but it’s not a whole Lotta good if I can’t find the download button thanks anyways. I have done. Google searches read all kinds of how to they all point to the very same button that I don’t have on my phone. I have an 11 Pro Max.
Podcasts stop after 5-10 mins.  All shows no logic to it.  App is broken.  Needs to be fixed.
Recent updates have made the app unusable; new podcast episodes not showing up, episodes stopping mid play and then restarting from beginning, no streaming, etc.
Have to give credit where it’s due. Most of the gaps with the redesign have been fixed and I’m seeing continuous improvements. Great job!

title.label: The redesign makes a lot of sense to me now.

content.label:
I was having issues for a couple weeks since the major redesign but now everything just seems to work (again). 

Really appreciate this app and frankly how it is affordable. I am seeing other apps charging a hefty sum every single month, and some even charging weekly. 

Overcast remains one of the best values that I am subscribed to. 

If you don’t want to add an auto insert fart noises feature, that’s fine. I guess your have “priorities”.

title.label: All the features I care about

content.label: All the features I care about for managing my feeds and listening are here.

This has been my go to podcast app for years. And I still like it. But the recent code rewrite has created a lot of bugs that are frustrating. I’m confident they’ll get fixed in time, but right now this app isn’t working the way it should.

I will happily edit this review when Overcast has a working CarPlay interface again. Its current state is UNUSABLE. I use CarPlay 99% of the time to listen to podcasts; to me, Overcast is a CarPlay exclusive app and this review reflects that.

Episode artwork disappears, no way to tell which episode is from which podcast until Overcast force quits

Now playing screen freezes, is late to update between episodes, shows incorrect artwork

Icons for the interface are often lost, replaced by blanks

This app is clearly from a developer that doesn’t use CarPlay regularly. 

This review is my last resort, as this dev is unresponsive to support requests otherwise. I know he doesn’t like this method but… What else is there?

Been an Overcast user for as long as I can remember (7+ years). It’s simple, user friendly and has creat customizations on nitpicky details. I’ve tried Apple and Spotify - both are unnecessarily complex if you ask me. Using Overcast is way better. Only feature it’s missing is Siri functionality but that’s a small miss.

title.label: Used to be great, now it’s annoying

content.label: I don’t know what happened. This used to be a great app. Now I can’t get episodes to load, auto play plays the most recent episode instead of the next one in sequence, and other little things I can’t remember at the moment. I like how you can use keywords to search for a specific episode, but when you click that episode it brings you to the podcast page instead of to the episode. So many little things are annoying with this app. I’m going to delete it, sadly. It could be great but attention to detail with the user experience isn’t there.
Was missing streaming and great to see it come back!
Great work from the developer on this. Amazing Application and one of my needs on my iPhone.
Downloading requires too many clicks. Swiping was superior in my opinion. At least streaming is back.
Very useful and user friendly

Still hoping for either smart playlists that can auto-populate using a search/filter term, or an option in search for ‘generate playlist from results’ (I keep replaying the Incomparable Game Show Low Definition) [[[Past issues now resolved:3/5 stars “From streaming instantly to waiting a minute per episode” My internet is gigabit, but podcast servers are not. Otherwise the update feels fine, though I often save up podcast episodes for moments when I feel I can digest the content, so the sleep timer being less accessible makes me sad when I might use it multiple times a day.]]]

This app is made by one amazing developer who just re-wrote the whole app to be able to keep it current and he now has the ability to fix bugs and add/test features much faster. It’s an amazing rewrite. There was one small irk I had, I made a report and now it is quietly fixed and I can sort my current and all lists separately. I’m sure this came up with other users but I am shocked at the speed of the fix.  Great job Marco! Thanks!

Update 2: It's back to being great. Episode limits are working again. The new stream to download flow fixes the big pain point of waiting to play an episode. This is the version that shouldve been released. I honestly don't know why you didn't wait 1 month to get the app to this state and release it. The new update is now, finally, and upgrade in every way to the prior design. Subscription renewal turned back on. 

Update: After nearly a decade of use the new update has rendered this app functionally useless. First, podcasts wouldn't continue to play after the prior one ended, the removal of download management has led to the size of this app balloning to nearly 20GB?? Playlists are somehow cometely broken and no longer seem to function in any sensible manner. Lastly, it seems episode limits are completely non-funtional. The app will now download and keep all episodes of a podcasts that are released since the date you subscribed, until you play them, even if you set an episode limit. I don't know exactly what the hell is going on here, but this trend of people/companies releasing updates to premium products as unfinished garbage, with existing features/functionality removed and forcing paying customers to act as beta testers is absurd. You are charging money for this app and it is worse today than it was a month ago. Get it together. I truly don't care for how you try to rationalize or equivocate away this failure on ATP or Under the Radar, this is unacceptable. Subscription renewal cancelled. 

Original: The best podcast app. Smart speed, voice boost and smart playlists are must have features. Truly a delight, worthy of 5 stars.
Been a huge fan of this app for years, and a subscriber a couple of times.  But I really dislike how many more taps it takes to play and download episodes now.  Hoping it gets changed back someday.

I forgave any loss of functionality in the new version because it was clearly so much faster and cleaner at the core. My giant library was very demanding and becoming a problem on my iPhone 11, I was prepared to just start fresh, but the new version largely solves the performance issues I was having.

Been a user since the first version and happy that the rewrite has sped things up and made shortcuts work better. Streaming is back so that’s great. Wish the widget would open up to last view and not overlapping views of the current podcast though.

title.label: Amazing, best Podcast App Ever! Glass of ice water in podcast hell

content.label: The best Podcast App, Glass of ice water in podcast hell, Continues to be the best podcast App including a new and awesome GUI and base layer refresh! Kudos to Marco! And thanks for bringing back streaming 🙏
Hands down the best player I've ever used

An awesome podcast app that has been transformed from the big over haul this summer! The app is very fast to interact with, and the new design is well thought out and implemented. 
With re adding podcast streaming this app is now perfect in my eyes.
Where did the limit # of podcast downloads by podcast go on the update?

title.label: The Big Rewrite Is Working Much Better Now

content.label: I wasn’t sure about the big rewrite at first, but it is really filling in now. Thanks for the continued updates and improvements.
The best podcast app there is. Period.
Love this app.
Glad to see streaming return!

title.label: Continues to be my favourite podcast app

content.label: This is the second review I’m writing after several years of using this app. Even with the new design updates, I still love it. There are some changes to get used to, but what I also love about this app is that the developer listens to feedback and actually implements those changes which I find is rare for many other apps. Thank you for an awesome podcast app that I will continue to hopefully use for many years to come!

I have used Overcast more or less since it first released and the new design overhaul is hands down my favourite layout we’ve had to date.

It’s also still orange, which I will never stop loving.

title.label: Redesign is a breath of fresh air

content.label: The new look really sets Overcast apart from other podcast players.  I’m loving it.
